objective.label: Viscosity ≤ 1.5 Pa·s
objective.why: Thinner resin recoats faster between layers, so dentures print faster.

guardrails.label: 3-pt bend
guardrails.source_note: Modeled on ISO 20795-1 denture-base values; verify before quoting.

guardrails.label: Bubbles (porosity)
guardrails.plain: Few bubbles in the cured part

guardrails.label: Cytotoxicity
guardrails.plain: Safe for cells: at least 70% survive

stations.label: Weigh
stations.card: Weigh base monomer, diluent and photoinitiator into a 50 g batch. The balance logs each addition, so the recipe is recorded as weighed, not as planned.

stations.label: Mix
stations.card: Mix at 3000 rpm for 2 minutes, per SOP v1. The mixer logs speed, duration and when the run ended.

stations.label: Degas
stations.card: Pull a vacuum on the mixed resin so trapped bubbles expand and escape. Not in SOP v1, and the degasser has no data interface, so it's only logged if someone writes it on their worksheet.

stations.label: Viscosity
stations.card: Measure viscosity at 25 °C. This is the objective: at most 1.5 Pa·s.

stations.label: Print
stations.card: Print 6 tensile dogbones and 3 bend bars. The printer logs when each job starts, which is how the rest time between mixing and printing is known.

stations.label: Post-cure
stations.card: Post-cure under UV at 60 °C for 45 minutes. The oven has no interface, so the time is entered by hand.

stations.label: Test
stations.card: Pull and bend the printed parts, image a cross-section for bubbles, and run the cell-viability assay. Results land in the log automatically.

notes.text: Baseline: 15% diluent, 0.6% PI.
Strong and ductile, UTS 44.8 MPa. But 2.6 Pa·s is way over target.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: Diluent up to 18%, PI 0.7%.
2.39 Pa·s. Still too thick.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: 20% diluent, PI up to 0.8%.
2.23 Pa·s, strength fine. Small steps aren't getting there.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: Parts look good. Nothing close to 1.5 yet.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: 24%: 1.98 Pa·s, best so far, still over.
Strength holding (UTS 50.6 MPa). Next: a big jump in diluent.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: Jumped to 34%. 1.44 Pa·s, under target!
UTS 35.6 MPa, below the floor. Cross-section full of voids (2.38%).

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: Snapped clean, no necking. UTS 35 MPa, porosity 2.75%.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: Brittle again: UTS 34.4 MPa, porosity 3.74%. High diluent seems to make it porous and brittle.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: Replicate of T08.
UTS 44.2 MPa, porosity 0.38%: nothing like T08. Anomalous, likely a lucky specimen. Excluded.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: 40%, PI up to 1.2% to help the cure.
Didn't help: UTS 30.7 MPa, porosity 5.22%. Calling high diluent a dead end.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: First trial, following the SOP walkthrough. 26% diluent, PI 1.5% for a stronger cure.
Everything passes. 1.85 Pa·s.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: All guardrails pass. 1.76 Pa·s.

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: 30%, PI back to 1.7%.
Brittle fracture, but strength is fine (UTS 49.3 MPa).

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

notes.text: 32%, PI 1.6%: 1.55 Pa·s. Closest yet, still above 1.5.
All pass. Might need a lower-viscosity diluent (DiluentX?).

log.event: Print job started: 6 dogbones + 3 bend bars

ledger.text: Low diluent (15–24%) passes every strength guardrail, but viscosity stays too high (1.98–2.60 Pa·s).
Dead end: high diluent (> 30%) too brittle.
ledger.status_note: Porous with brittle fracture; UTS 30.7–35.6 MPa, below the 40 MPa floor in 4 of 4 included trials. T09 excluded as anomalous.

ledger.text: Can we reach 1.5 Pa·s without new materials?

team.label: As the team saw it
team.description: All 13 included trials pooled (T09 left out, as its owner excluded it). Pass/fail fitted on diluent, the variable the dead end was declared on.

degas.label: Split by degassing
degas.description: Predicted pass region for degassed resin. Bubbles (porosity) fitted from all 14 trials, then pass/fail on diluent, photoinitiator and bubbles. Only 4 degassed trials exist, all at ≤ 32% diluent; beyond that it's extrapolated, supported only by T09.
